title: eriastrum densifolium subsp. mohavense
intro: Eriastrum densifolium subsp. mohavense, commonly known as the Mojave gilia, is a rare and endemic plant species found in the Mojave Desert region of California. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Eriastrum densifolium subsp. mohavense are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
